title: Spaghetti & Meatballs
description: Tender meatballs simmered in a simple tomato sauce.
imageAlt: Spaghetti and meatballs in tomato sauce

items: ½ cup grated Parmesan, plus more to serve

steps.title: Soak the crumbs
steps.text: Stir the breadcrumbs and milk together and leave 5 minutes.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Mix the crumbs with the remaining meatball ingredients until just combined. Roll into 18 balls and set on a lined sheet.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Bake at 425°F until browned, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.text: Warm the oil and garlic in a wide pot over medium-low until fragrant. Add the tomatoes, basil, and salt and simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer together
steps.text: Add the meatballs and simmer gently for 20 minutes, until they reach 160°F.

steps.title: Boil and toss
steps.text: Cook the spaghetti in salted water, drain, and toss with some sauce. Top with the meatballs and Parmesan.
